use_when.text: Cards also contain other components in slot area.
use_when.source: Figma 69:1498 (Cards Doc Frame › Do, text I69:1498;2406:461;69:1495)

use_when.text: Cards can serve as entry points into deeper levels of detail or navigation, such as a music album or details on an upcoming vacation.
use_when.source: Figma 69:1498 (Cards Doc Frame › Do, text I69:1498;2406:461;69:1495)

use_when.text: Contents can include anything from images to headlines, supporting text, buttons and lists.
use_when.source: Figma 69:1498 (Cards Doc Frame › Do, text I69:1498;2406:461;69:1495)

use_when.text: Use cards to display contents and actions on a single topic.
use_when.source: Figma 69:1498 (Cards Doc Frame › Do, text I69:1498;2406:461;69:1495)

use_when.text: Cards should be easy to scan for relevant and actionable information.
use_when.source: Figma 69:1498 (Cards Doc Frame › Do, text I69:1498;2406:461;69:1495)

use_when.text: Maintain consistent spacing, padding, and alignment across similar cards.
use_when.source: Figma 69:1498 (Cards Doc Frame › Do, text I69:1498;2406:461;69:1495)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t scroll within a card to reveal information.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 69:1498 (Cards Doc Frame › Don’t, text I69:1498;2406:416;69:1488)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t use multiple competing CTAs within a single card.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 69:1498 (Cards Doc Frame › Don’t, text I69:1498;2406:416;69:1488)

dont_use_when.text: Card shouldn’t contain that can be swiped, such as image carousel or pagination. Also, swipe gestures shouldn’t cause portions of cards to detach upon swiping.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 69:1498 (Cards Doc Frame › Don’t, text I69:1498;2406:416;69:1488)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t create inconsistent card sizes, spacing, or layouts for similar content.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 69:1498 (Cards Doc Frame › Don’t, text I69:1498;2406:416;69:1488)

dont_use_when.text: On a mobile device, cards can’t internally scroll, as it could use two scroll bars to be displayed.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 69:1498 (Cards Doc Frame › Don’t, text I69:1498;2406:416;69:1488)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t make the entire card clickable unless the whole card represents a single action.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 69:1498 (Cards Doc Frame › Don’t, text I69:1498;2406:416;69:1488)

dont_use_when.text: Don’t let cards bump other elements out of the way. When a card is picked up, it appears in front of all elements, except app bars and navigation.
dont_use_when.source: Figma 69:1498 (Cards Doc Frame › Don’t, text I69:1498;2406:416;69:1488)
